GATES N/A. 1b (frontend lint/typecheck): no frontend/** in the diff. 1c (live UI capture): the criteria make no UI claims; the live_check here is an MCP tool response, whose numerics I REPRODUCED MYSELF to 16 significant digits rather than relying on Main's capture -- no degraded-fallback disclosure needed. Code-review heuristics: single test file, production byte-unchanged; no secrets, no tautological assertions (assert calls / assert r["pbo"] is None are behavioural and I killed both by mutation), no over-mocking (the spy patches the DEPENDENCY and delegates to the real function, never the subject under test), no financial-logic change without a behavioural test.

CREDIT WHERE DUE. Cycle 3 did the unglamorous thing properly: five mechanical record fixes, every one landing exactly where the cycle-2 verdict named it, with the cycle-1 fenced capture deliberately preserved rather than quietly rewritten. Two details raise this above compliance. First, the census was re-run AFTER the final edit -- the discipline that was missing in cycle 2 -- and it survives a broader independent rule AND a known-member recall test with an empty symmetric difference at line level, which is a stronger result than the criterion asks for. Second, the serialization note is the rare case where a Q/A NOTE was not just applied but PROVEN: the 6dp-rounding hypothesis reproduces the captured column_corr_mean to all 16 digits while leaving the rank-based PBO bit-identical, which is affirmative evidence the AFTER capture was taken over the live MCP surface rather than copied from a local run. The one number that does not reproduce is a self-referential count over a corpus that grows when you write about it -- the least consequential thing left in the artifact, and I would rather see it deleted than re-measured.
